offers.title: Data Analyst
offers.description:
Tallgrove Analytics helps parcel and retail companies understand their delivery data. We are hiring a data analyst for our Nordic team.

Our stack: SQL, Python, Looker Studio, Excel, Airflow and dbt. You will build reports for operations managers and keep the weekly dashboards accurate.

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience
- Comfort with SQL and spreadsheets
- Clear written communication

Nice to have: pandas, Tableau.

We work remotely across Sweden and meet in person twice a year.

Fluent English required.

offers.title: Analytics Engineer
offers.description:
Quarry Lane Software builds planning tools for warehouses. Our data team is small and works closely with product.

Requirements
- 5+ years of experience with data work
- Strong SQL and Python
- Experience with dbt and Looker Studio

Nice to have: pandas.

Hybrid role in Stockholm, two office days a week. Fluent English.

offers.title: Support Operations Analyst
offers.description:
Mossby Support Services runs outsourced customer support for retail brands. We need an analyst who keeps our help-desk data clean and our reports on time.

Requirements
- 2+ years in a support operations or reporting role
- Zendesk administration and SQL
- Tableau is required for our client dashboards.

Nice to have: Google Sheets, Looker Studio.

On-site in Malmö, five days a week. Fluent English and Swedish.

offers.title: Junior Reporting Analyst
offers.description:
Example Bank is looking for a junior reporting analyst to join the finance reporting team in Stockholm.

Requirements
- At least 1 year of experience with reporting
- Excel, SQL and Looker Studio
- Swedish and English, written and spoken

Nice to have: Python.

Office based, five days a week.

offers.title: Analityk danych, zespół raportów (k/m)
offers.description:
Szukamy analityka danych do zespołu raportów.

Wymagania
- SQL, Excel, Power BI
- Biegły polski i angielski

offers.title: Sales Representative
offers.description:
Tinwhistle Leads books meetings for software vendors. Call prospects, qualify them and book demos.

Pay: this role is commission-based only. There is no base salary.

Fluent English.

offers.title: Revenue Reporting Analyst
offers.description:
Harrowmere Hotels runs twelve hotels in Scandinavia. You will report on bookings and room revenue.

Requirements
- 2+ years of experience with SQL and Excel
- Looker Studio or a similar tool

Fluent English.

offers.title: Branch Office Coordinator
offers.description:
Requirements
- 2+ years of office experience
- Excel, Tableau and dbt
